name: OverdraftCustomerNotified
trigger: Customer notification dispatched for the overdraft review outcome. Marks the review as notified and records the notification timestamp.
capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001). Terminal event in the review lifecycle.

payload_schema.notification_channels: array of string (push | email | in_app | letter)
payload_schema.persistent_debt_intervention_sent: boolean — true if CONC 6.7 intervention letter was sent

consumers.action: Records customer notification completion for Consumer Duty and CONC 6.7 audit evidence. Confirms the bank fulfilled its notification obligation.

ordering_guarantees: Per-account ordering. Terminal event — follows EVT-117 for the same review_id.
worm_rationale: Evidence that customer was notified of review outcome within required timeframe. FCA CONC 6.7 and Consumer Duty notification obligation. 7-year retention.
